limitations: No complete semantic reference was supplied or inferred.
Controlled arithmetic variants must be independently declared to preserve semantics.
A detected difference is not a proof of nonzero population mean bias.
A passed property is not a proof of full functional equivalence.
Training gradient, optimizer update, and loss consequences are not measured here.

DECLARED_REDUCTION_ORDER_VARIANT.interpretation: Difference is evidence that the declared arithmetic choice matters; it is not by itself rounding bias or a training claim.

symmetry.interpretation: For a symmetric round-to-nearest reduction, negating all operands should negate the order difference; this is a diagnostic symmetry check, not a bias proof.
